defect_summary: The previous ChatGPT-authored procedure specified detailed context replay and handshake semantics but left Gemini access as an abstract 'available/bound Gemini interface'. It nevertheless marked its MetaProcedure self-evaluation PASS.
repair_requirement: The new procedure must make Gemini access executable and observable by binding its send/receive operations to the supplied PromptGemini mechanism and must rerun affected MetaProcedure evaluations before claiming compliance.
